# Municipal Ordinance No. 04, Series of 2007

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 04**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance No. 04 (Kautusang Bayan Blg. 04), Series of [[2007]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on October 22, 2007. This ordinance prohibits the cutting of bakawan (mangroves) and other trees (kahoy) in coastal barangays, tidal areas (ilalim ng dagat), and public lands within the municipality of Pitogo, Quezon. It aims to protect mangrove forests and coastal ecosystems.

## Key Provisions

- **Section 1** — It is prohibited to cut, destroy, or remove bakawan (mangroves) and other trees in barangay coastal areas, tidal zones, and public lands within the municipality.
- **Section 2** — Prohibits the cutting of trees along lakeside and coastal areas in forests and barangay boundaries.
- **Section 3** — Prohibits the cutting of trees of any kind, whether timber or fruit-bearing, along the shores, coastline, and areas adjacent to the sea and bayshore.
- **Section 4** — Any person found violating this ordinance shall be fined Two Thousand Pesos (P2,000.00) for the first offense, with subsequent penalties of up to Two Hundred Pesos (P200.00) additional fine and one hundred (100) hours of community service.
- **Section 5** — Violators shall also be reported to the Tanggapan ng Pulisya (Police), Tanggapan ng Pangasiwaan ng Kapaligiran (DENR), and the Sangguniang Barangay for appropriate action.
- **Section 6** — Enforcement shall be by the Tanggapan ng Pulisya, Tanggapan ng Pangasiwaan ng Kapaligiran, and the municipal/barangay authorities.
- **Section 7** — This ordinance shall supersede any prior ordinance on the same subject.
- **Section 8** — This ordinance shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication.

### Penalty Summary
| Offense | Fine | Community Service |
|---------|------|-------------------|
| First | P2,000.00 | — |
| Subsequent | Up to P200.00 additional | Up to 100 hours |
